status: Task 5 review complete 2026-09-13. Candidate provenance only; approves no candidate and promotes nothing.

originality.attestation: Every mark in all three candidates is generated by code authored in this repository from the project's own approved documents. No image was traced, sampled, generated by a model, or copied from any external source; no external asset is fetched at build time, and the only external URL in the candidate sources is the SVG XML namespace. No named living artist's style was sought or imitated, and no commercial product's distinctive visual identity — palette, iconography, layout signature or avatar system — was reproduced. The isometric projection is standard trigonometry and carries no authorship claim.

gaps.finding: Zero architectural, material, ergonomic, photographic or historical references were consulted, although the brief expressly permits them to establish general qualities. The candidates are original because nothing external informed them, which is not the same as being well researched.
gaps.disposition: Recorded as open for the owner at Task 8. It does not block Tasks 2-4, whose acceptance is the twelve board deliverables against the frozen frame. If the owner wants a candidate grounded in observed studio architecture or real material behaviour, that is a bounded addition to the selected candidate in Task 9, not a reason to reject the set.

gaps.finding: Decision 6-C approved a hybrid medium, but no generated raster exploration was produced. Each manifest records generatedExploration as null rather than implying coverage.
gaps.disposition: Open. An image model cannot render six specific agents at declared work areas with one active work item, so the generated half can only ever supply material and mood plates, never board item 1. The owner may decide the remaining value does not justify the provenance burden, since generated assets are the one category whose training provenance this register cannot enumerate.

gaps.finding: Two of the six named typefaces are proprietary system faces that cannot be embedded. Today this costs nothing, because the candidates only name them in a fallback stack.
gaps.disposition: Deferred to Phase 7 with a named trigger: the moment any candidate's type is embedded rather than system-resolved, a licence review is required. Cascadia Mono under SIL OFL 1.1 is the only named face that would survive that review unchanged.
